summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Panchasikha teaching King Janaka that death and decay are inevitable, and only knowledge of the eternal path transcends the cycle of birth and death.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Panchasikha stands before King Janaka in his court, explaining as the king listens intently on his throne.
Human beings are swept helplessly down a vast river of time where two monstrous alligators named Decrepitude and Death lurk in the waters.
Cloud-like masses of people drift together and separate in a windy sky, symbolizing fleeting human relationships.
